newsitem.title: GERMANY: Adidas confirms marketing deal with N.Y. Yankees.
newsitem.headline: Adidas confirms marketing deal with N.Y. Yankees.

text.p: Adidas AG, the German sportswear maker, confirmed Tuesday that it had signed a marketing deal with the New York Yankees baseball team.
"We have signed an agreement for broad cooperation in marketing," an Adidas spokesman said in answer to an inquiry.
He declined to provide any details, including financial arrangements.
The Wall Street Journal had reported that the Adidas deal with the Yankees, winners of last year's World Series, was roughly $100 million, but the Adidas spokesman called this "pure speculation."
